topics.name: Depth camera noise & denoising
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:"depth camera" AND (abs:noise OR abs:denoising OR abs:denoise)
cat:cs.CV AND (abs:"depth denoising" OR abs:"depth restoration" OR abs:"depth enhancement")

topics.name: Time-of-flight & depth sensors
queries: cat:cs.CV AND (abs:"time-of-flight" OR abs:"ToF camera") AND (abs:noise OR abs:simulation OR abs:denoising)
cat:cs.CV AND abs:LiDAR AND (abs:simulation OR abs:sim2real) AND (abs:noise OR abs:"domain gap")

topics.name: Structured light
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:"structured light" AND (abs:simulation OR abs:noise OR abs:reconstruction OR abs:speckle)

topics.name: Point cloud denoising
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:"point cloud" AND (abs:denoising OR abs:"noise removal")

topics.name: Depth sim2real / real2sim
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:depth AND (abs:sim2real OR abs:"sim-to-real" OR abs:"sim to real")
cat:cs.RO AND abs:depth AND (abs:simulation OR abs:sim2real) AND (abs:noise OR abs:sensor)

topics.name: Learned sensor noise synthesis
queries: cat:cs.CV AND (abs:"noise model" OR abs:"noise synthesis") AND (abs:camera OR abs:sensor OR abs:depth)
